query:
SELECT
            id            as "id!",
            app_id        as "app_id!",
            status        as "status!: DeployStatus",
            builder       as "builder!: BuilderType",
            image_tag     as "image_tag",
            created_at    as "created_at!: _",
            finished_at   as "finished_at: _"
           FROM deployments
           WHERE app_id = ?1 AND status = 'live'
           ORDER BY created_at DESC
           LIMIT 1
